resources.string: Keep local control of your data, with an encrypted Homika Cloud backup when you need it.
Create an encrypted cloud backup tied to your active Homika Pro licence. The backup is encrypted on this device before it is uploaded.
Homika compresses and encrypts the backup with AES-256-GCM before upload. Cloud storage receives only the encrypted backup blob.
Cloud Backup Phase 2 automatically queues local changes. Edits are grouped for 30 seconds, uploads are limited to at most once every 2 minutes, and pending changes retry when Homika starts again.
